findings.note: H.3750 'An Act to provide identification to youth and adults experiencing homelessness' (lead petitioner James J. O'Day with Sean Garballey) would have the Registrar of Motor Vehicles provide identification to people experiencing homelessness. The bill text does not mention voting; it is saved only as related to access to government-issued ID. Reported favorably by committee 2026-01-27 and sent to House Ways and Means.
subjects: access to state-issued ID (homeless residents), not voting-specific
